•HOW IT WORKS

One system. Every surface.

01

Create your structure

Set up folders, lists, and tasks in any client. The tree is yours to shape — infinitely deep, always organized.

02

Manage everywhere

CLI on terminal, web on browser, mobile on the go. One account — same data, every surface.

03

Track progress

Daily scores, streaks, and visual graphs. Every completed node earns points. Keep the momentum.

•FEATURES

Everything you need. Nothing you don't.

Infinite Nesting

Tasks nest infinitely. No depth limit. Structure matches how you actually think.

CLI-First TUI

Full keyboard-driven terminal UI. Add, complete, and navigate without leaving the terminal.

Gamified Scoring

Daily completion scores. Streaks. Visual graphs. Finishing tasks feels rewarding.

Cross-Platform Sync

One account. Real-time sync across CLI, web app, and mobile. Your tree is always current.

Smart Daily View

Nodes with today's date auto-surface in Daily View. No manual task sorting.

Tag System

Global and list-scoped tags. Filter across your entire tree or within a single list.

•FOR DEVELOPERS

Your terminal. Your productivity.

The StrataNodex CLI is a full TUI — not just a wrapper around a web app. Keyboard-driven. Infinitely nestable. Published on npm.

•WEB APP

The same tree. Now draggable.

The web app renders your task tree on an infinite pannable canvas. Drag nodes, expand branches, and edit everything in a side panel. The same data. A completely different experience.

  • ✦Pannable infinite canvas
  • ✦Drag-to-reposition nodes
  • ✦Right-panel node editor
  • ✦Daily breakdown + graphs
•MOBILE APP

In your pocket.

React Native. Same account. Add tasks on the go, check your daily view, and keep the streak alive.
